goal: 连接冻结输入、持久化和审核适配器，交付可补跑且历史隔离的单审/双审 CLI。

interface_contracts.name: entry
interface_contracts.definition: python -m multi_agent freeze/run/show/retry/confirm（benchmark 入口由 T-0014 顺序接入）; freeze stores input+hash in SQLite; run selects exactly 1 or 2 distinct model IDs and explicit efforts, immutable round. Default data outside target repo. run creates separate readonly snapshot directories and identical initial prompt for blind seats; asyncio parallel; failed only retry same config/snapshot; show includes history and reported unknowns. No auto accept/merge/rework execution.

interface_contracts.name: persistence
interface_contracts.definition: ReviewStore existing apply remains only current-attempt writer, same transaction. Add snapshot inputs and round execution/confirmation metadata via 0002 migration, no editing old migrations. No new attempt/round states necessary; assessment derived from frozen input/current successful reports. Interrupted running attempts shown as recoverable; explicit recovery only if no live owner. CLI confirmations validate IDs/round, max one cross-confirmation round, only blockers, completed independent reports required. confirm 用继承席位配置的独立只读运行时会话生成结果，不把手填 JSON 当模型结论。使用现有 RoundState/attempt 机制建立 parent_round_id 关联的唯一子轮次（confirmation prompt/schema），完整记录来源与重试证据；仅在双方原报告齐全后启动，只传 P0/P1。测试输入文件包含 required_commands 和 results，只有声明的全部命令通过才可能 ready；显示 user_supplied 来源。 confirmation 仅限双审父轮次，创建子轮次与 UNIQUE parent 约束同一事务；seat 由执行上下文绑定，目标必须是另一席位阻塞项。Ctrl-C 持久化 CancelRequested，调用 adapter.cancel，等终态/停止，保留成功席位。 T-0015 提供存储API和迁移，本卡复用不修改store。CLI进程持有数据库级非阻塞flock串行派发，轮内双审并行；show可并行读。遗留running显式recover后用category=None终止旧控制尝试，进程exit仍未知；遗留cancelling缺终态证据保持未完成。

interface_contracts.name: runner and confirmation boundary
interface_contracts.definition: runner.make_adapter(config:SeatConfig,log_dir:Path,metadata:dict,schema:dict)->Adapter is test factory boundary. async execute_round(store,round_id,directory,*,stop:asyncio.Event|None=None)->None; caller holds execution_lock(directory). Confirmation runtime output exact {summary:string,confirmations:[{target_seat,finding_id,decision:agree|disagree|uncertain,reason}]}; seat is bound by runner, never accepted from output. Targets must be other original seat P0/P1. Unanswered targets recorded as missing, not fabricated confirmations. main command returns0 for processed runs (consult JSON assessment),2 for invalid CLI input. Output top status is existing RoundStatus, assessment.status is ready|needs_rework|user_decision|incomplete. Global data-dir; run SNAPSHOT_ID --seat PROVIDER MODEL EFFORT repeat; show [ROUND_ID] --history; retry ROUND_ID --seat KEY repeat --recover; confirm ROUND_ID.

interface_contracts.name: unconfirmed cancellation
interface_contracts.definition: 复核发现运行时cleanup失败仍报告取消的依赖缺陷，本卡收紧runtime与runner：已启动子进程但清理失败且无真实terminal/exit时不得合成CANCELLED；adapter保留Error(category=None,raw_type=adapter.cleanup_incomplete)和未知exit，runner不将它送入CANCELLING转移，而是保留未完成并记录不确定证据。从未启动进程可before-launch取消，实际终态或exit可确认。新增回归，状态/事件枚举不变。

deliverables: 连接冻结输入、持久化和审核适配器，交付可补跑且历史隔离的单审/双审 CLI。
docs/deliveries/T-0013.md：开工 HEAD、验收对应、路径、检查与限制
acceptance_criteria: unit/replay：单审只启一个；双审并行相同冻结输入且无对方报告；全部齐全才评估。
unit/replay：失败补跑仅失败席位，保留成功报告和配置；旧终态只进历史；新代码产生新快照旧报告仍可查；进程重启可展示历史与待恢复状态。
unit：schema错误转失败不污染 core；无测试证据明确待用户决定；外部数据目录、独立席位目录；CLI 参数错误无模型调用。
迁移升级已有 v1 DB 仍保留轮次历史；新增回放同时检查最终状态和历史；完整 verify。
docs 给出 freeze/run/show/retry 操作和真实请求由用户运行、测试证据为用户提供、只读与 Codex 配置隔离限制；不实现阶段 2/3。
